title: 15. INSTALL AIR INTAKE CHAMBER WITH CONNECTOR
ocr_text:
15. INSTALL AIR INTAKE CHAMBER WITH CONNECTOR
(a) Position a new gasket on the intake manifold.
(b) (7M-GTE)
Connect the cold start injector connector.

(c) Install the intake chamber with connector and vacuum transmitting pipes with the two cap nuts and five bolts.
Torque: 180 kg-cm (13 ft-lb, 18 N·m)
(d) Connect the engine wire to the clamps of the intake chamber.

(e) Install new gaskets and cold start injector tube.
Torque: To delivery pipe
300 kg-cm (22 ft-lb, 29 N·m)
To cold start injector
180 kg-cm (13 ft-lb, 18 N·m)
(f) Install the EGR vacuum modulator to the bracket.

(g) (7M-GE)
Install the air intake connector bracket mounting bolts.

(h) (7M-GE)
Install the throttle body brackets.
